formal.rate: each path calibrated independently and then locked; no changes inside measurement
formal.paired_recovery: at most two recalibration rounds with complete pair replacements; every unmatched pair retained and identified

calibration.rate_bound_note: use stricter bound if helper mutation reservation includes seed; legal full formal trial must fit 300000 planned mutations

qualification: DB process CPU measured over complete fixed formal measurement
both paths within target ±5% and pair CPU relative-to-mean difference ≤5% for a matched pair
API/UNKNOWN/drop/scheduler lag/client CPU/Weir CPU are preserved; sustained frontend or generator bottleneck is separately reported
no interpolated throughput or CPU-normalized estimates substituted for matched live values
same write semantics and corpus; reset only owned fixture collection/index before each trial; full APPLIED content audit
observation: authoritative DB PID/startticks/container/restarts and actual quota/memory
process and cgroup CPU separately; RSS/cache/IO/CFS/GC are not implied equal by CPU matching
20s warm and 60s measure separate; keep every 10s window
owned fixture cleanup and independent inventory/NotFound/port-forward proof

only one CPU target; not the maximum throughput curve

cpu_sampling.scope: all available authoritative DB process samples within full fixed formal nominal60s measurement; never select individual10s buckets
cpu_sampling.cpu_formula: (last CPU ticks - first CPU ticks)/CLK_TCK/(last actual sample time - first actual sample time)
cpu_sampling.counter_span_note: 1Hz MongoDB or existing ES subsecond sampler normally covers about59s; report actual span/coverage. Throughput still successful operations divided by fixed60s. No extra remote boundary commands.

cpu_timing: /proc counter read lies in saved request/read bracket. health_gate: CPU matched and health qualified are distinct; only joint qualification used as stable-capacity evidence. Matching CPU does not match IO/RSS or isolate pool size.
